liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alligator** (2 reviews): The Alligator, Caution and Feedback sequence closes the Anthem of the Sun remaster; Alligator runs about 4:02, drums 2:32, Alligator 2:49, then a brief 16-second drums section [7][13]
- **New Potato Caboose** (1 review): Reviewer finds New Potato Caboose creative and unique [15]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Garcia leads into Dark Star at a medium tempo, with strong band support [15]
- **St. Stephen** (1 review): On 8/23 St. Stephen has a William Tell bridge into The Eleven, unlike the filler's Answer Man jam [14]

## The recordings

- **gd68-08-23.sbd.sacks.52.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 133 min; rated 4.29/5 by 34 [1]. Said about its sound: Mix changes suddenly from the second Cryptical on, suggesting another tape source; detailed but muddy, improves with EQ [10]
- **gd1968-08-23.153116.sbd.8trackmix.gems.flac16**: soundboard; 12 songs; 86 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Cut between The Eleven and Death Don't Have No Mercy, but very little is missing [2]
- **gd1968-08-23.sbd.sniper777.tomP.116193.flac16**: soundboard; 10 songs; 86 min; rated 4.29/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: Stereo image hole fixed, noise reduced, instruments clearer, and channels rebalanced to centre the image [3]
- **gd1968-08-23.143130.sbd.partial.miller.gastwirt.sirmick.flac1644**: soundboard; 3 songs; 34 min [4]

## Around the show

- A second Shrine show was recorded too, but police stopped it during Morning Dew [7]
- The filler labeled 8-29-68 clearly isn't part of 8-23; its St. Stephen is only about 15 seconds [13]
- Performance judged better than Two From The Vault, though mastering and mixing are less polished [11]
- None of this material appears on Two From The Vault, which is entirely from 8.24.68 [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd68-08-23.sbd.sacks.52.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Darrin Sacks; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Both Shrine shows were recorded multitrack; The release combines two source materials, with extra filler material from the 29th; the original eight tracks sound great [7][11]
- **gd1968-08-23.153116.sbd.8trackmix.gems.flac16**: transferred by Mastering by Jim Blackwood Speed Correction by Jason Chastain Track, FLAC and Pack by Steve Gravel; source: Vault Master 8-track Reel > Studio 2-track Mixdown (Dan Healy) > CAS > DAT [2]. Also: Taken from a Dead Air broadcast on KXCI Tucson, August 22, 2021, hosted by Jim Blackwood and Jamie Waddell [2]
- **gd1968-08-23.sbd.sniper777.tomP.116193.flac16**: transferred by TomP; source: two SBD sources [3]
- **gd1968-08-23.143130.sbd.partial.miller.gastwirt.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: SBD > 8 Track Master Reel > PCM > DAT (44.1k) - Provided by Rich Gastwirt [4]. Also: Four small patches in Alligator come from the Darrin Sacks source, shnid 52 [4]
